verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a built-in AI Assistant inside the Dashboard. It generates schema SQL from specifications, diagnoses SQL errors, and gives context-aware table recommendations. It also offers a delegation path to generate and deploy Edge Functions directly via the Assistant. The MCP and plugin evidence covers external agents, not the built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-dashboard assistant, and documentation of how far it autonomously executes actions (e.g., running migrations or SQL itself) beyond generating and suggesting, apart from Edge Function deployment.
